To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

pH-sensitive polymeric micelles composed of histidine, phenylalanine, and folate can effectively deliver DOX to the MDR ovarian tumor in vivo, and the drug carrier can be further optimized for more effective tumor targeting.

the second generation of pH-responsive polymeric micelles, which target both folate receptors and pH 6.0, are superior to their first generation, which targets pH 6.5 and folate receptors, in suppressing the growth of existing multidrug-resistant (MDRx) ovarian tumors in mice.
the second generation of pH-responsive micelles targeting early endosomal pH and folate receptors effectively delivered DOX to the MDR tumor and inhibited the tumor growth in mice.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a new drug delivery system that is capable of overcoming the limitations of existing drug delivery systems.
the development of a novel micelle formulation that can effectively deliver DOX to tumors and overcome the drug-resistance problem in ovarian cancer.
the design of a pH-sensitive drug carrier for intracellular drug delivery to MDR tumors, which is expected to be a promising strategy for cancer therapy.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the second generation of pH-responsive micelle formulations targeting folate receptors at pH 6.0 is an efficient drug delivery system for MDR tumors.
the micelle formulation targeting pH 6.0 and folate receptor was effective in suppressing the growth of MDR tumors in vivo.
pH-sensitive micelles targeting both pH 6.0 and folate receptors were effective for treating MDR tumors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the pH 6.0-targeting micelles were superior to the micelles targeting pH 6.5 and 6.8.
the pH-sensitive micelle formulation is an effective and safe therapeutic strategy for treating MDR ovarian cancer.
the micelle formulation with the second-generation polymer targeting both pH 6.0 and folate receptor is a promising drug delivery system for MDR ovarian tumors.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the pH-sensitive drug carrier targeting early endosomal pH and folate receptor has potential for the treatment of MDR tumors.
the second generation of pH-responsive micelles can be used as a drug carrier for MDR ovarian tumors.
the second generation of pH-responsive micelles is a promising platform for the treatment of solid tumors, particularly MDR tumors.
